sentences.en: August 24th, 1814, marked the first and only time Washington, D.C.

sentences.en: The United States was two years into the War of 1812.

sentences.en: They'd taken on Great Britain, which was then the greatest naval power in the world.

sentences.en: And things weren't looking great for the American troops defending D.C.

sentences.en: British forces overtook the city and set fire to historic American landmarks including the Treasury Building, the Capitol Building, and even the White House.
sentences.zh: 英军攻占了这座城市，并纵火烧毁了许多美国历史地标，包括财政部大楼、国会大厦，甚至还有白宫。

sentences.en: The siege became known as the Burning of Washington.
sentences.zh: 这场围困后来被称为“华盛顿大火”。

sentences.en: But then a freak occurrence, which in any other situation would have been a total disaster for D.C., saved the city.
sentences.zh: 但随后发生的一件奇事拯救了这座城市，这在任何其他情况下对华盛顿来说都是一场彻底的灾难。

sentences.en: Dark clouds began to form, which turned into thunder and lightning,
sentences.zh: 天空中开始聚集乌云，随之电闪雷鸣，

sentences.en: which then turned into a full-blown tornado that headed straight for the British, who were setting fires around the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 接着演变成一场不期而至的龙卷风，径直朝正在国会大厦周围放火的英军袭去。

sentences.en: A number of British soldiers were killed by fallen debris, and the fires were extinguished by the rain.
sentences.zh: 不少英军士兵死于落下的残骸，大火也被雨水扑灭。

sentences.en: The British retreated back to their ships, which had been severely damaged by the storm.
sentences.zh: 英军狼狈撤回他们的船只，而这些船只此前已在风暴中严重受损。

sentences.en: Thanks to a simple act of weather, the occupation of our nation's Capitol was over within a little more than a day.
sentences.zh: 多亏了一场寻常的天气现象，这场对我们国家首都的占领在一天多一点的时间里就结束了。

sentences.en: The storm that saved Washington was just one of countless times that weather played a crucial factor in war.
sentences.zh: 拯救华盛顿的风暴只是天气在战争中发挥关键作用的无数次事件之一。

sentences.zh: 拿破仑的军队不是被俄军击败的，而是被俄罗斯的冬天击败的。

sentences.en: And during World War II, General Patton famously distributed 250,000 prayer cards to the army

sentences.zh: 号召尽可能多的士兵祈祷雨停。

sentences.en: The battlefield has always been at the mercy of the climate.
But there was a time in U.S.
military history when we did more than just pray for advantageous weather.
sentences.zh: 军事史上曾有一段时间，我们的做法不仅仅是祈求有利的天气。

sentences.en: Fighting communist guerrillas in South Vietnam continues a slow grind.

sentences.zh: 从20世纪50年代开始并延续到60和70年代，

sentences.zh: 深度卷入了南北越之间的战争。

sentences.en: North Vietnam was supported by the Soviet Union, China, and other communist allies.
sentences.zh: 北越得到了苏联、中国及其他共产主义盟友的支持。

sentences.en: South Vietnam was supported by the U.S.

sentences.en: It was a total mismatch from that standpoint.
sentences.zh: 从这个角度来看，这是一场极其不对等的较量。

sentences.en: It was us against a guerrilla army that showed up occasionally and then disappeared, vanished.
sentences.zh: 是我们对阵一支偶尔出现随后又消失得无影无踪的游击队。

sentences.en: And we spent the next, you know, months looking for it,

sentences.zh: 然后他们突然出现，接着又消失了。

sentences.zh: 一支与北越结盟但在南方为主作战的共产主义武装力量。

sentences.en: One of the Viet Cong's greatest advantages was the Ho Chi Minh Trail,
sentences.zh: 越共最大的优势之一就是胡志明小道，

sentences.en: a supply route that ran from North Vietnam through parts of Laos and Cambodia into South Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 这是一条从北越经老挝和柬埔寨部分地区延伸至南越的补给线。

sentences.en: Hundreds of thousands of North Vietnamese troops used it to infiltrate the South with weapons and supplies.
sentences.zh: 数十万北越军队利用这条路线将武器和物资输送到南方。

sentences.en: It traveled through an isolated region full of rugged mountains and dense jungles.
sentences.zh: 它穿过一个充满崇山峻岭和茂密丛林的偏远地区。

sentences.en: The trail itself was made up of dirt paths and handmade tunnels.
sentences.zh: 小道本身由泥土小路和手工挖造的隧道组成。

sentences.en: Along the way, there were hidden bunkers, barracks,
sentences.zh: 沿途设有隐藏的掩体、兵营，

sentences.en: and even hospitals cleverly camouflaged from above.
sentences.zh: 甚至是巧妙地从空中伪装起来的医院。
这简直是一个工程奇迹。
它并不是一条单一的道路。

sentences.en: It was a network, a maze of roads.
sentences.zh: 它是一个网络，一个道路的迷宫。

sentences.en: The covert trail system dramatically shortened the journey from North to South Vietnam,
sentences.zh: 这条隐蔽的小道系统极大地缩短了从北越到南越的行程，

sentences.en: meaning more troops, more weapons, and more North Vietnamese support
sentences.zh: 这意味着能够为南方的共产主义武装

sentences.zh: 提供更多的部队、更多的武器以及更多的北越支援。

sentences.en: And the key thing was, that's how all their supplies,
sentences.zh: 最关键的是，他们所有的物资——

sentences.en: as they supplied both the Viet Cong and also their own forces,
sentences.zh: 因为他们要同时为越共以及他们自己的部队提供补给——

sentences.zh: 为了切断对于军事行动至关重要的补给，

sentences.zh: 我们必须通过各种手段关闭这条小道。

sentences.en: military tried disrupting the trail with bombing campaigns
sentences.zh: 曾试图通过轰炸行动以及用推土机铲平丛林来破坏这条小道。

sentences.en: So whenever we punched a hole in one part of it, they simply moved over to a bypass.
sentences.zh: 只有一件事能够显著减缓胡志明小道上的物资和人员流动。

sentences.en: There was only one thing that significantly slowed the flow of supplies and people on the Ho Chi Minh Trail.

sentences.zh: 现实情况是，由于小道的性质，它受到了强降雨的影响。

sentences.en: The reality was that because of the nature of the trail, it was affected by heavy rainfall.

sentences.en: So they had the same problem, of course, as we did in terms of trails that were very, very muddy with the rain.
